messages.text: Hello. I’m interested in buying the Doge Hammer DC08 miner but I live in Europe (France). Do you ship to Europe and could you please tell me if the power supply/ plug is adapted to France ? Thank you
Read the hammer miner dc08 page

Yes, we ship to France. The D.08 has one variant, "US / EU (matched to your address)", so a France address gets the EU plug and the matching 250W power supply, both in the box with the power cord. Nothing to adapt on your side.

It's $539.00 USD, 480 MH/s Scrypt at about 137W, WiFi or ethernet, around 50 dB.

Want me to set up the cart so you can see shipping to your address at checkout?
